instructions:
1. Grip the bar with both hands close together, palms facing each other, one hand in front of the other.
2. Hang with arms fully extended and body straight.
3. Pull your body up and lean your head to one side of the bar until your chin clears the bar.
4. Lower under control until arms are fully extended.
5. Pull up again, leaning your head to the other side of the bar.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your body straight and resist rotation on every rep.
2. Lower slowly to control the movement.
3. Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears.
4. Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your legs apart.
2. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand and rest your right elbow against the inside of your right thigh.
3. Let the dumbbell hang with your arm fully extended.
4. Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow against your thigh.
5. Lower the dumbbell under control until your arm is fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the biceps at the top of the curl.
2. Keep your upper arm still against your thigh.
3. Use a weight you can control through a full range of motion.
4. Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back and raise your legs overhead until your feet reach toward the floor behind your head.
2. Hold one foot with both hands.
3. Release the other leg and lift it straight up until it points to the ceiling.
4. Hold the position and keep your balance.
5. Lower the leg back to the start and switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and keep control of each leg.
2. Keep your shoulders on the floor and do not strain your neck.
3. Exhale as you lift the leg, inhale as you lower it.
4. Use a mat to support your back.

instructions:
1. Stand in a semi-lunge with your left leg bent and your right leg extended behind you.
2. Raise your right arm overhead and lower your left arm to your side.
3. Brace your core and rotate your torso to face the opposite side.
4. As you rotate, lower your right arm and raise your left arm overhead.
5. Rotate back to the start, switching arm positions again.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Rotate with control to protect your lower back.
2. Keep your feet planted and stay balanced.
3. Keep the movement smooth and deliberate.
4. Exhale as you rotate, inhale as you return.

instructions:
1. Stand facing a wall corner with your feet shoulder-width apart, about 30 cm from the corner.
2. Place your forearms and palms flat on each wall at shoulder height.
3. Lean your body forward into the corner.
4. Push your chest toward the corner until you feel a stretch across your chest and shoulders.
5. Hold the position.
6. Step back to release and repeat.
tips:
1. Increase the lean gradually as the muscles loosen.
2. Stop at a gentle stretch, not pain.
3. Keep your palms and forearms flat against the wall.
4. Breathe deeply and steadily throughout.
